notes.title: MAJOR DEMO UPDATE + RELEASE
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! It has been a while but there has been a lot of progress made in the time since the last update. There has been an overhaul to the entire game. And with that new overhaul, there is now a new demo. 

The new demo is better than the last one by far. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42009485/a4234df042d14b18d2084a3bf68ce1ccc06c83f1.png

There is also a new website for the game! (Either search up "Secrets For Taking" or use the link.) 
secretsfortaking.com

Some of the new features of the new demo include: 

 Zones 
 NEW Fighting System
 Level System 
 Hidden Secrets to be Found. 
 Currency 
 Shop System 
 Better art
 Better music 
 Secret-Taking System 
 Removed Conversation Sprites (They were bad lol) 


Here's a video of the demo. This is from a build from a couple days ago prior to release. For those who are interested in taking a peak: 
https://www.instagram.com/p/C8BQZjouBDZ/

Not everything in the video is seen in the demo, so go out and find the secrets hidden ;) 

Thank you to everyone who was supportive to me when developing the game. 
I have made a lot of progress with this, and I hope you all enjoy it!!

- Max

notes.title: Secrets For Taking - Demo Release!
notes.notes:
The release of the Demo is here! 

Here's what to expect: 

 15-30 Minutes of Gameplay! 
 A bad Ost. 
 Funny cutscenes.
 3 Boss Fights! 
 World Building + Setting up the Story!!
 And you take a Secret!!!
 With even more additions too!


I hope that everyone will enjoy this demo! There will be more content that will come out soon. Thank you so much guys!!

notes.title: Secrets For Taking - Demo Part 1 Release Date!
notes.notes:
Demo Release Date: 

After months and months of development (I even had to restart the development twice!), Secrets For Taking will release its first half of the demo! Originally, I planned to delay the demo by another month or two, but that wouldn't be fair to people who want to play the demo.

January 16th, that will be the release date for the first encore of the demo! 
(Unless specified otherwise. If there was a delay though, it would only be for a couple day though.)

What to expect: 

This demo will show how the rest of the game will look. Below are the expectations for part 1 and part 2:

This is what the first half of the demo will look like: 


 Play through 2 areas of the game. (DANN's World and Keysing City)
 Go through 2 boss fights! 
 Learn about the origins of the main characters and how the story sets off.
 1 Chase sequence.
 Take someone's secret. (Obviously)
 Listen to some decent music.
 Introduce characters that will join Mash.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42009485/a84a13907b4d63a00531fdfbb5e59281650f8709.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42009485/6bc455c5a15376b254df8a62737877b485b13c89.png

This is what the second half of the demo will look like: 


 Finish playing through Keysing City (and maybe even play through another area....?)
 Go through one major, plot-breaking, boss fight!
 Be able to access shops, which can gain you more powerful abilities and items.
 Able to have more battles with enemies that are in the city.
 Maybe introduce another member to the party?


Obviously, the second half of the demo has more features than the first one. But, I feel that instead of delaying the demo by another couple of months, this would be a nice way for you guys to get to play the game and enjoy its features! 

Other Announcement: 

Thank you to all of you guys who wishlisted my game! Secrets For Taking now has 100+ wishlists! 
(As of December 22, 2022, Secrets For Taking has 117 wishlists!) 

Now let's see if we can get to 200! (or possibly even higher!)

I hope that all of you guys will be able to enjoy my game! This is a major passion project of mine, and I understand that some people will be disappointed with the quality of my game. But, that's to be expected.

Thank you!
